note: Inyo NF campground in one large loop under Jeffrey pines off Old Sawmill Road, beside New Shady Rest and Pine Glen and within walking distance of the town of Mammoth Lakes; a paved walking and biking path runs to the neighbouring campgrounds and town. The dump station charges $10 a use; showers are in town. --Claude
